regions.merged_text: P.S. Dear Joseph: I shall inform Father Provincial of your proposition and will probably hear from him before long. He naturally must feel a relief whenever he finds anyone able and willing to help in such a financial difficulty.

regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your recent favors - duly received and noted. We are preparing for the glorious Feast of Corpus Christi this Thursday and next Sunday - with procession and Benediction at the Monastery - garden Shrine, at 2:30 the latter date. It would be an edifying treat - the only time in the year that the Garden is open to Cath. public. . . . Furthermore, since our Father Provincial was called to Rome to be Most Rev. General; we are to have a provincial Chapter, July 11 - 14th. Please help us storm Heaven for guidance. . . Praised be Jesus!
